description: This Java source file contains parameterized JUnit test cases for testing the sorting functionality of a persistence layer in a 'thingsearch' service, specifically testing the sorting of 'Thing' objects based on various attributes, including IDs, string attributes, and long attributes, with different sort directions.

classes.name: SortingIT
classes.description: Parameterized JUnit test class for verifying sorting functionality of 'Thing' objects in persistence layer, including sorting by IDs, string attributes, and long attributes with various sort directions.

methods.name: sortPerDefaultByThingIdAsc
methods.description: Tests default sorting behavior of 'Thing' objects by their IDs in ascending order.

methods.name: sortByThingId
methods.description: Tests sorting of 'Thing' objects by their IDs in the specified sort direction.

methods.name: sortByStringAttribute
methods.description: Tests sorting of 'Thing' objects based on a string attribute.

methods.name: sortByStringAttributeWithDots
methods.description: Tests sorting of 'Thing' objects based on a string attribute key with dots.

methods.name: sortByLongAttribute
methods.description: Tests sorting of 'Thing' objects based on a long attribute value.

methods.name: sortByLongPropertyWithDots
methods.description: Tests sorting of 'Thing' objects based on a long property within features, with feature id and property key containing dots.

methods.name: runTestWithLongValues
methods.description: Helper to create and test sorting with long values for specified sort options.

methods.name: runTestWithStringValues
methods.description: Helper to create and test sorting with string values for specified sort options.

methods.name: runInternallyWithThings
methods.description: Executes sorting test logic using created 'Thing' objects and validates sorted result.

methods.name: getStringAttributesThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function that builds 'Thing' objects with specified string attribute values.

methods.name: getLongAttributesThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function that builds 'Thing' objects with specified long attribute values.

methods.name: getStringAttributesWithDotsThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function that builds 'Thing' objects with string attributes keys containing dots.

methods.name: getLongPropertyWithDotsThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function that builds 'Thing' objects with features containing properties keys with dots.

methods.name: createAndPersistThings
methods.description: Creates and persists a list of 'Thing' objects based on a collection of values and a builder function.

methods.name: extractStringField
methods.description: Extracts string value from a 'Thing' based on the provided sort field expression.

methods.name: extractLongField
methods.description: Extracts long value from a 'Thing' based on the provided sort field expression.

methods.name: createExpectedResult
methods.description: Creates expected sorted list of 'ThingId's based on provided sort criteria and comparator.

methods.name: randomThingId
methods.description: Generates a random 'ThingId' within the namespace for testing purposes.
